## Checklist

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under "Unreleased" (or the PR has the `no-changelog` label)
- [ ] Tests cover the change (`pytest -m "not live"`), and the live test still passes if the API contract changed
- [ ] Only public model names (`chakra-ts`, `chakra-tab`) appear in code, docs and examples
